scientific_integrity: An exact finite proof is supplied and a standalone exact-rational checker independently reproduces finite cases. Earlier general methods may implicitly cover the expression. No independent audit or validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Only nearest-neighbor symmetric random-walk bridges, one-sided spatial maximum, and positive-time zero returns including the final endpoint. No claim of stochastic negative association, unbiased bridges, absolute extrema, or historical first discovery.
title: Exact return–maximum anticorrelation in tied-down simple random walks
